back: A frozen, versioned, representative set of series and forecast origins used to compare models. It is not used for tuning.
Champion is the production model. A challenger must beat it under written rules before it is promoted.

front: Four parts of a promotion rule?
back: Average gain over a margin, win rate across series, no important segment worse than a limit, and a live check.

front: Name three causes of the offline-online gap.
back: Leakage, different data timing live, decisions changing the data, selection effects, and a golden set that is not representative.
Pushing the metric up without helping the business, such as under-forecasting to lower MAPE. Defend with several metrics and segment reports.
The best of many tried models has a partly lucky score, so its live result is usually worse.
